tests.test: Validate mirrored boot and redundant workload pool
tests.pass: All expected devices healthy and redundancy active
Management is isolated and production links are healthy
Secure Boot/TPM, firewall, SSH keys, AppArmor and time sync pass
Compose config validates and services start cleanly
HTTP success and node identity NODE01
Registry responds and is not publicly bound
Control plane and registry recover from backup
Previous approved image can be restored and health verified
External route terminates TLS and reaches only approved private workload

release_rule: All tests required for the applicable deployment stage must pass before promotion. Physical tests cannot be marked passed from repository CI alone.
